WHAT’S GETTING ATTENTION

City pulse. Less noise.

A small, date-aware edit of events, food, shops and culture. Evidence—not a claim to measure citywide popularity.

No Reddit or Instagram signals qualified this refresh. This edit uses dated publications and official supporting links; access limits are listed below.

culture

SVA’s free alumni film festival has weekend screenings

SVA Theatre’s free festival continues September 26-27 with animation and documentary screenings plus Q&As. RSVPs are appreciated but the page warns seating is first-come, first-served and guests/films can change.

Report + official supportLatest signal 2026-09-26
See the evidence
  • Official2026-09-26 · Official SVA Theatre page lists September 26 KPop Demon Hunters and The Stringer screenings and a September 27 Cutting Through Rocks screening.
culture

New Museum’s reopening slate adds a fresh Bowery art stop

The New Museum’s homepage, modified September 24, highlights a reopened building with Arthur Jafa, Diego Marcon, Bowery history and Ho Tzu Nyen exhibitions. Useful as a new Lower East Side museum outing; check timed tickets and hours.

Report + official supportLatest signal 2026-09-24
See the evidence
  • Official2026-09-24 · Page metadata shows a September 24 modification and the page states the New Museum opens four new exhibitions on September 24.
food

Oberon brings all-day dining inside the New Museum

Oberon is newly highlighted on the New Museum site as an all-day restaurant and bar from the Oberon Group, with seasonal cooking and art-world design collaborations. It is a visitable food add-on to the museum rather than a time-limited pop-up.

Report + official supportLatest signal 2026-09-24
See the evidence
  • Official2026-09-24 · Official page metadata was modified September 24 and describes Oberon’s operator, chef, hours, access and location inside the New Museum.
shops

FIT’s fashion fundraiser continues online after the in-person sale

The Chelsea in-person sale is over, but FIT’s official page says a CharityBuzz auction remains open with archive and celebrity-closet pieces. It is online rather than a walk-in NYC sale, and the page ties proceeds to FIT student scholarships and programs.

Report + official supportLatest signal 2026-09-24
See the evidence
  • Official2026-09-24 · Official FIT page says the CharityBuzz auction is available until October 8 and separately lists the September 23-24 in-person shopping schedule as ended.
shops

CJ Hendry’s Flower Market is a short-run Rockefeller Center art-shopping activation

TheSkint lists the activation through Sunday: oversized plush blooms inspired by New York flowers, with the first flower free and additional flowers priced at $5. Rockefeller Center’s official page was blocked in this session, so verify hours before going and expect lines.

Single-source watchLatest signal 2026-09-26
See the evidence
  • Publication2026-09-26 · TheSkint ongoing-events page lists CJ Hendry’s Flower Market through September 27 at Rockefeller Center and notes pricing and likely lines.
food

The Feast of San Gennaro is in its final weekend

Little Italy’s long-running street feast remains a straightforward food-and-stroll option through Sunday, with vendors and neighborhood programming; expect crowds and check weather before going.

Report + official supportLatest signal 2026-09-17
See the evidence
  • Official2026-09-17 · Official site states the 2026 Feast runs Thursday September 17 through Sunday September 27 in Little Italy.
